content.comment_body: My goal is to access the [product_name] webserver over the internet. I set up the device in [product_name] Soft Comfort, but the IP and gateway settings didn't match my router, so I had to manually configure these on the device after finishing the programming. I also set up port forwarding on my router using port 8080. I suppose having a static (non-dynamic) IP is necessary for long-term monitoring. Network configuration isn't my strongest area, but I believe you need a static IP address to connect to the device via [product_name] Soft Comfort from the internet. Can anyone advise how to set the network password (for an ASUS AC66U in this case) on the device? Any tips or help would be appreciated. Thanks!
The [product_name] ships with the default password "[product_name]".
What I mean is the network I'm trying to connect the [product_name] to requires a password before allowing traffic.
My initial mistake was using the wrong IP for the [product_name]: "192.168.0.200" instead of "192.168.1.200". My router used "192.168.1.1". The image shows my first test.
Before I update my IP settings, does this link work for anyone? [url] Thanks

Hello, I'm also trying to make my [product_name] webserver accessible from the internet, but I haven't succeeded yet. Why are you using this public IP [url], rather than 192.168.1.200, which is your device's internal IP? Regards, [user_name]

192.168.1.200 is a local IP inside your network. You can't access it externally unless you're using a VPN. The 83.x.x.x address is part of the public IP range. Use Google to search "MYIP" to see your own WAN address.
Hi, My public IP is 116.87.118.176—should I proceed with this? Thanks a lot. Regards, [user_name]

Hello, Please refer to this FAQ: To enable and access the web server on [product_name], set up port forwarding in your router—external port 8080 to internal port 8080, directed to IP address 192.168.1.200 ([product_name] IP address). On your office PC (local side): Connect using https://[public IP]:8080, for example https://116.87.118.176:8080.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to set up remote access to the [product_name] web server online and face uncertainty about required actions, notably network configuration, IP addressing (internal versus public), and password entry for connecting [product_name] controllers to networks. The discussion highlights a lack of understanding of basic networking principles, such as differentiating between public and local IPs and handling port forwarding. There is confusion regarding how to enter network authentication or WiFi credentials into the hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily configure network access for [product_name] devices, including setting WiFi passwords or required credentials, and to achieve remote web access without needing complex network knowledge. They also want clear guidance on configuring internal and public network setups.
